description: docker's answer: contexts {contexts, sections}; list {columns, rows}; inspect {text, file}; logs {text}; exec {text, status}; start, stop, restart and remove {said}; fault when Docker can't be reached; missing when there's no docker.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

contexts.description: contexts: docker's contexts, and Colima's and Podman's found besides.

text.description: inspect: what docker inspect says of it; logs: its last lines; exec: what the command wrote, its stdout and stderr together.

file.description: inspect: what it is called, for its highlighting.

said.description: start, stop, restart, remove: what docker said.

status.description: exec: the command's exit status (docker's, if it couldn't run it).

missing.description: docker isn't on the host: the Docker view shows this in its place.
